$comment: What WaitTimeout says when a wait runs out of time, per state of the decision it last read: both SDKs' suites read this file (packages/acp-client/src/client.test.ts, sdk/python/tests/test_client.py) and must print exactly `line`. `last` null means no read answered. The TypeScript client is handed timeout_seconds * 1000 milliseconds.

cases.line: decision 01J0WAITPENDING was still waiting to be decided when the wait ended after 30s: read the decision again later with its id, and never propose the same action again
decision 01J0WAITNOREAD was still waiting to be decided when the wait ended after 0.5s: read the decision again later with its id, and never propose the same action again
decision 01J0WAITHELD was held for an approver when the wait ended after 900s: read the decision again later with its id, and never propose the same action again
decision 01J0WAITHELDUNTIL was held for an approver when the wait ended after 2s: read the decision again later with its id, and never propose the same action again
decision 01J0WAITNORECEIPT was decided and its receipt was not readable yet when the wait ended after 0.03s: read the decision again later with its id, and never propose the same action again
